_note: Cases for the persona stats probe (harness/persona-stats-chip-probe.cli.ts). Sedge Landing under no persona, so the Custom Persona entity's stats are the player's: Calm low (rattled), and a Resolve that clashes with the world's Resolve, so it reads as "Resolve (2)". The entity stats of entity-stats-chip-cases.json ride in both arms. `checks` name scorers in the harness. Narration cases run the action; planning cases run the storyboard planner on a fixed scene; choices cases run a fixed passage.

cases.narration: Bram stands at the landing with the raft rope slack in his hand. He answers you with a short nod and does not meet your eye. The river runs high behind him, brown and quick, and the far bank sits a long pull away.
Odette turns the last few eels on the rack without looking up. Smoke curls past her face. She waits, one hand on the rack, for you to say what you came for.
